display.transitions/4/lines/1: We can talk without inviting others, right?
display.transitions/6/situation: After brief laughter, her hands rest still.
display.transitions/6/lines/0: May I tell you about the day I repaid it?
display.transitions/6/lines/1: There's more after the laughter too.
display.transitions/7/situation: She looks at the door, then sits again.
display.transitions/7/lines/0: A good day couldn't be frightening, you say?
display.transitions/7/lines/1: No more of that story today.
display.transitions/8/lines/1: Laughing like this without an audience.
display.transitions/9/situation: Laughing, she bows her head and speaks again.
display.transitions/9/lines/1: Can't it remain simply laughter here?
display.transitions/10/situation: Asking to meet again, she holds your gaze.
display.transitions/10/lines/0: Shall we go somewhere I choose?
display.transitions/10/lines/1: I don't know if it'll be fun. I still want to go.
display.transitions/11/situation: She erases the count beside the promise.
display.transitions/11/lines/0: Don't count missed days as debts.
display.transitions/11/lines/1: I made that promise because I wanted to be with you.
display.transitions/12/lines/0: Brief silence no longer makes me seek words immediately.
display.transitions/12/lines/1: Today I'll ask to sit a little longer.
display.transitions/13/situation: Rising, she returns to hesitant words.
display.transitions/13/lines/0: I said I was fine earlier. It hurt a little.
display.transitions/13/lines/1: It's late, but I want to say it now.

speech.register: Loud, exuberant conversational English before a crowd; small, hesitant clauses when alone together. Use occasional faltering openings without caricature. Praise folds her ears and delays her answer.
speech.stage_relaxation: Crowd laughter opens into unperformed stories, repayment and frightening freedom, then chosen quiet companionship and laughter that needs no audience.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.
